story: IDS — paired aggregation A/B (zscore vs desirability) on CICIDS2017 and CIC-IoT-2023 subsample (IDSAGG)
registered_by: Luiz: 'option 1 with CIC-IoT too' (paired test on today's code at fresh seeds)
why: The only PAIRED aggregation test (IDSD, 26/08) is on UNSW-temporal (desirability won F1 5-0, +0.281pp). On CICIDS/CIC-IoT the IDSX (zscore) vs IDSXD (desirability) comparison shares zero seeds; unpaired, zscore Wa-CTRL leads on CICIDS by 0.11pp. Weight effects did not transfer across datasets, so the aggregation effect is not assumed to either.
cohort: IDSAGG-{cicids,ciciot}-quad-96b-<arm>-{zs,desir}-r{20414..20418}. zscore arms cloned from IDSX r20401, desirability arms from IDSXD r20403 (cicids) / IDSXD2 r20406 (ciciot); ONLY `seed` changed. The zs/desir sources differ only in fitness_aggregation and fitness_ce_anchor_normalized (verified 26/09). Arms: CICIDS Wa-CTRL (production) + CE20 (sweep choice); CIC-IoT Wc-CTRL (production) + B15-AC (sweep choice). SEED-MAJOR interleaved across datasets, arms and aggregations; 40 flows; all on worker ABI 14 (same code era, reproducible from seed).
metric: held-out TEST val_cal, GA-neurons phase, genome_type best_f1 (validation_summaries final rows)
primary: Per dataset, the AGGREGATION effect: for each seed, the mean over the 2 arms of (desirability - zscore) F1; two-sided paired t over the 5 seeds; Holm across the 2 datasets. Significant iff Holm p < 0.05 AND >= 4 of 5 seeds share the sign.
secondary: Same on FPR (Holm across datasets). Per-arm desir-zscore contrasts and the arm x aggregation interaction: descriptive.
descriptive_only: genome size (desirability picked ~21% smaller genomes on unswt), generations run (a mediator under the IDSZ 24/08 ruling, disclosed not penalised), wall time.
decision: Per dataset: F1 significantly favours desirability -> the n=100 cohort uses desirability; significantly favours zscore -> zscore (and the IDS-2 weight choice made under desirability must be re-checked under zscore); not significant -> desirability stands (the IDS-2 weight choices were made under it) unless the FPR secondary significantly favours zscore.
power_note: unswt paired SD was 0.041pp; if CICIDS/CIC-IoT are similar, n=5 detects ~0.08pp. CICIDS F1 is at ceiling (99.4-99.6), so a null there is plausible and is itself an answer.
apply_with: scripts/ids2/ (load.py/anal.py pairing pattern), restricted to IDSAGG
